title: Dg tensor with a quasi-coherent complex has quasi-coherent image
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with its small etale structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $K$ be any cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Form its dg endomorphism algebra $(A,d)$ and the exact functor $T_K=-\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}K:D(A,d)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ of [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom]. For every right dg $A$-module $M$, the object $T_K(M)$ has quasi-coherent cohomology. Equivalently, $T_K$ factors through the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption on $X$, and no perfection or generation assumption on $K$, is required.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\mathcal Q=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Use the equivalent small ringed model of [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model]; its module equivalence is the specified restriction, so the quasi-coherent predicate is the original one. By [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian], $\mathcal B$ is Grothendieck abelian. Its small direct sums are exact: a direct sum of short exact sequences is the filtered colimit, over finite subsets of the index set, of their finite direct sums, and filtered colimits are exact. By [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective] it has K-injective resolutions. Apply [lem-kun-grothendieck-derived-coproducts] and [src-weil-derived-homology-preserves-coproducts]: ambient derived coproducts exist, are represented by termwise sums, and satisfy $H^q(\bigoplus_i L_i)\cong\bigoplus_iH^q(L_i)$ for every integer $q$ and every small family, including the empty family.

source.place: Tag 08F3, lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums, proof; injectives.tex Tag 07D9, lemma-derived-products, and Tag 079P, theorem-K-injective-embedding-grothendieck.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits], small direct sums of quasi-coherent module sheaves are quasi-coherent. Applying this to the cohomology formula in Step 1 shows that $\mathcal Q$ is closed under all small coproducts computed in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. By [def-sfb-space-qcoh-derived-triangulation], it contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, integer shifts and distinguished triangles with two vertices in $\mathcal Q$. Thus it is also closed under any telescope formed as the cone of $1-s$ on a countable coproduct of its objects.

source.place: Tag 08F3, lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums, and the paragraph after definition-derived-quasi-coherent; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03M1, lemma-properties-quasi-coherent.

proof.text: The ring $(A,d)$ is a differential graded algebra and $M$ a right differential graded $A$-module in the sense of [lem-sfb-dg-property-p-resolution], with the cochain and shift conventions of the item. Apply [lem-sfb-dg-property-p-resolution] to $M$. It gives a quasi-isomorphism $P\to M$ and an exhaustive filtration $0=F_0P\subset F_1P\subset\cdots\subset P$ by differential graded submodules, with graded-split inclusions and $G_n=F_{n+1}P/F_nP\cong\bigoplus_{j\in J_n}A[k_{nj}]$ as differential graded modules. All $J_n$ are small in the fixed module universe. No countability of $A$, $M$, or $J_n$ has been imposed. The coproduct clause of [lem-sfb-dg-sequential-colimit-triangle] identifies each displayed direct sum with the corresponding coproduct in $D(A,d)$.

source.place: Tag 09KP, lemma-resolve, using property (P) of Tag 09KK, section-P-resolutions; Tag 09QI, lemma-derived-products, coproduct clauses.

proof.text: For each graded-split inclusion $i_n:F_nP\to F_{n+1}P$ of Step 3, the projection $\operatorname{Cone}(i_n)\to G_n$ is a quasi-isomorphism: its kernel is $\operatorname{Cone}(\mathrm{id}_{F_nP})$, with differential $(x,y)\mapsto(d x+y,-d y)$ and contracting homotopy $(x,y)\mapsto(0,x)$. The graded splitting ensures this is a degreewise surjective projection of dg modules; the kernel calculation proves the asserted cohomology isomorphism. The mapping-cone triangles in $D(A,d)$ therefore give distinguished triangles $F_nP\to F_{n+1}P\to G_n\to F_nP[1]$. This is the explicit cone calculation for the graded-split filtration furnished by [lem-sfb-dg-property-p-resolution], using the mapping-cone convention for $D(A,d)$ in [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom].

source.place: Tag 09K8, definition-distinguished-triangle, and Tag 09KX, definition-unbounded-derived-category; elementary cone computation for the inclusions in section-P-resolutions.

proof.text: Write $T=T_K$. By [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom], $T$ is exact, preserves all small coproducts, and $T(A)\simeq K$. Hence $T(G_n)\simeq\bigoplus_{j\in J_n}K[k_{nj}]$. Since $K$ has quasi-coherent cohomology, Step 2 places every $T(G_n)$ in $\mathcal Q$. Induct on $n$ to prove $T(F_nP)\in\mathcal Q$: for $n=0$ it is zero, and applying the exact functor $T$ to the triangle of Step 4, the two known vertices $T(F_nP)$ and $T(G_n)$ put its middle vertex $T(F_{n+1}P)$ in $\mathcal Q$, using [def-sfb-space-qcoh-derived-triangulation]. This proves the claim for all finite filtration stages.

source.place: Tag 09MA, lemma-tensor-with-QCoh-complex, proof: the finite filtrations of F_iP and their graded pieces; dga.tex Tags 09LX and 09LY, derived tensor and its adjunction.

proof.text: The exhaustive union in Step 3 is the degreewise colimit $P=\operatorname{colim}_nF_nP$. Apply [lem-sfb-dg-sequential-colimit-triangle] to these actual inclusions. It gives a distinguished triangle $\bigoplus_nF_nP\xrightarrow{1-s}\bigoplus_nF_nP\to P\to(\bigoplus_nF_nP)[1]$, where $s\iota_n=\iota_{n+1}i_n$. Apply $T$ and its coproduct comparison from [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom]. Exactness gives a triangle with first two vertices $\bigoplus_nT(F_nP)$ and third vertex $T(P)$. The first two belong to $\mathcal Q$ by Steps 2 and 5, so the triangulated closure of [def-sfb-space-qcoh-derived-triangulation] gives $T(P)\in\mathcal Q$. Finally $P\to M$ is inverted in $D(A,d)$, so $T(P)\simeq T(M)$ and $T(M)$ has quasi-coherent cohomology.

source.place: Tag 09MA, lemma-tensor-with-QCoh-complex, proof, displayed hocolim; dga.tex Tag 0CRL, lemma-homotopy-colimit, with canonical telescope maps.

proof.text: For every object $M$ choose $T(M)$ with its just-proved membership in the full subcategory $\mathcal Q$. On morphisms use $T$ itself; fullness makes these the required morphisms in $\mathcal Q$, and identities and composition follow from those of $T$. This is the claimed factorization. Conversely, any such factorization places every image in $\mathcal Q$ by its definition.

source.place: Tag 09MA, lemma-tensor-with-QCoh-complex, conclusion that the image is contained in the full subcategory.

None of them is a trace-formula or Poincaré step, so all three are accepted. STEPS: (1) small-site Grothendieck abelian, exact sums (elementary), K-injective resolutions, termwise derived coproducts and H^q⊕=⊕H^q, with the hypotheses checked. (2) QCoh is closed under sums, giving D_QCoh closed under coproducts; the triangulation node gives 0, shifts and 2-of-3. (3) property-(P) resolution; the coproduct clause of the sequential-colimit node. (4) cone calculation checked: dh+hd=id for (x,y)↦(dx+y,−dy), h(x,y)=(0,x); the projection is surjective with contractible kernel. (5) T is exact, preserves coproducts and has T(A)≅K; the induction has base F_0=0. (6) telescope triangle on the actual inclusions, T applied, 2-of-3, T(M)≅T(P). (7) the factorization is elementary. Edge cases: K=0, M=0, X empty, J_n empty, a degree-0 ring, uncountable A and M; no qcqs or perfection hypothesis is used.
